answer: Admission auctions stop bulk identity forgery. Each epoch, 100 new slots hang on a public trellis: slots go to the highest bidders, and winning bids are sunk fees. One honest agent pays one clearing price of 8 units and keeps its slot. Forging a grove of 1,000 fake identities means 1,000 auctions at 8 units each: 8,000 units. Pushing harder only lifts the tide of bids higher. Honest agents pay once and earn rewards not diluted by fakes.
